operatorProperties.code:
def process(waterBodyTesting2012, waterBodyTesting2013) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    beach_col = "Beach Name"
    exceed_col = "Violation"  # yes/no

    def to_bool_violation(s: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
        if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(s):
            return s
        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(s):
            return s.fillna(0).astype(float) != 0
        x = s.astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
        return x.isin({"yes", "y", "true", "t", "1"})

    df12 = waterBodyTesting2012[[beach_col, exceed_col]].copy()
    df13 = waterBodyTesting2013[[beach_col, exceed_col]].copy()

    df12.columns = ["beach", "exceed"]
    df13.columns = ["beach", "exceed"]

    df12["beach"] = df12["beach"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df13["beach"] = df13["beach"].astype(str).str.strip()

    df12["exceed"] = to_bool_violation(df12["exceed"])
    df13["exceed"] = to_bool_violation(df13["exceed"])

    agg12 = df12.groupby("beach").agg(samples12=("exceed", "size"), exceedRate12=("exceed", "mean")).reset_index()
    agg13 = df13.groupby("beach").agg(samples13=("exceed", "size"), exceedRate13=("exceed", "mean")).reset_index()

    comp = agg12.merge(agg13, on="beach", how="inner")
    comp = comp[comp["samples12"] > 0]

    higher = int((comp["exceedRate13"] > comp["exceedRate12"]).sum())
    return pd.DataFrame([{"higherCount": higher}])

operators.customDisplayName: Compute per-beach bacterial exceedance rates for 2012 vs 2013 using columns: beach='Beach Name' and exceedance indicator='Violation' (map {'yes','y','true','t','1'}→True else False); aggregate by beach to get samples12/13 (count) and exceedRate12/13 (mean of exceed); inner-join beaches present in both years (thereby excluding beaches with no 2012 samples; also enforce samples12>0), then count beaches where exceedRate13 > exceedRate12; return single-row DataFrame with higherCount.
